fields.description: Block CRM emails sent from an address the user is not allowed to use (ABM Email Sender, User Emails or default outgoing account). System Managers are exempt.
fields.label: Enforce Sender Rules

fields.description: Also offer the accounts listed in the user's own User Emails table
fields.label: Include User's Email Accounts

fields.description: Also offer the site's default outgoing Email Account
fields.label: Include Default Outgoing Account

fields.description: Two-letter country code (ISO 3166) used for numbers saved without a country code, e.g. IN for India. 9876543210 becomes +91 98765 43210.
fields.label: Default Phone Region

fields.description: Click to Chat is free: buttons open the rep's own WhatsApp (app or WhatsApp Web) with the message typed in. Cloud API sends from inside the CRM and needs a Meta WhatsApp Business account (frappe_whatsapp app).
fields.label: WhatsApp Mode

fields.description: Which phone calls the mobile app saves as call logs. CRM numbers only keeps calls with numbers that belong to a lead, deal or contact; All calls keeps every call.
fields.label: Call Sync Scope

fields.description: Ask the mobile app to upload call recordings, when the phone records calls
fields.label: Upload Call Recordings

fields.description: Send push notifications to the mobile app through Firebase Cloud Messaging
fields.label: Enable Push Notifications

fields.description: Firebase service account key (JSON) with permission to send messages. Firebase console > Project settings > Service accounts > Generate new private key.
fields.label: FCM Service Account
